dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast light-to-mid-grey jagged perimeters forming closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' shapes. The gradient transition is sharp, moving from a bright, thin (2-5 pixel width) perimeter to a dark interior core. Edges exhibit high-frequency crenulation rather than smooth curves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid-white high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients. These are primarily concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region and scattered along the lower-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli—located in the central-lateral, mid-dorsal, and posterior-lateral regions—form a scalene triangle with the widest interior angle oriented toward the central-lateral vertex.
